_doc: Fun-metric limits and baseline for run_bot_test.py --fun-check (see fun_report.py). First-reward, wait and rewards medians from the 8-bot, 180 s WebSocket run on 2026-11-23 (four runs: first reward 7.4-8.5 s, rewards/min 4.2-6.2, wait 0.01 s). Skills and dead time re-taken 2026-11-23 after gameplay's #98 kept bots gathering (three local runs, 8 bots x 180 s, WebSocket + Postgres): bots levelled 8/8/7, first level-up after 33.7/34.7/39.7 s of gathering (median; worst 39.8-54.0), longest dead time median 35.1/38.2/22.6 s (worst 46.8-54.4), rewards/min 9.9-10.6. bots_levelled_min is 6 so one slow CI runner doesn't flake; longest_dead_s_worst is 75 s (worst seen 54) and the median is compared against 35 s with 10 s slack. rewards_per_min baseline raised from 4.15 to 8.0 to lock in #98's gain (fails below 6.4); raise it to ~10 once CI runs confirm it. Re-taken 2026-11-23 from CI: the nine `main` push runs since #98 (fun_trend.py) levelled 8/8 every time, rewards/min 9.57-11.07 (median 10.0), longest dead median 31.3-50.75 (median 40.5) and worst 55-72. The 35 s dead baseline with 10 s slack failed `main` at 50.75 (b603fb2), so it is now 40 s with 15 s slack (fails above 55 s); worst limit 85 s (pre-#98 CI saw 81.8). rewards_per_min baseline 10.0 (fails below 8.0) and bots_levelled_min 7. 2026-11-23 (ws/qa/fun-real-gathering): the metrics now read protocol v3/v4 messages (a press of E, a cancel and a Craft press are actions; our gather bar, XP and craft results are feedback; s2c_gather_result and s2c_level_up count rewards and level-ups, with their text echo dropped). Two local 8 x 180 s WebSocket runs: first reward 7.5/7.1 s (worst 10.6/9.7), wait 0.09/0.08 s (worst 0.25/0.23, presses of E included), rewards/min 10.7/10.3 (unchanged, so nothing is double counted), dead median 27.7/29.9. Baseline kept (CI is the authority, see the dead-time flake above); first_reward_s_worst tightened 120 -> 90 s: CI's last nine runs were 8.9-10.7 s worst. 2026-11-24 (ws/qa/steady-levelled-gate): bots_levelled_min 7 -> 6. It turned `main` red on d9927b3 with 6/8 although nothing in the game changed (that PR only added a bot run after the main one): the two bots that missed had gathered 43.8 s, inside the 29.5-49.9 s the levelled bots needed that run, because each bot's XP is split between felling and quarrying by whichever nodes it happens to walk to. 9 of the 10 CI runs before it were 8/8. A slower curve is still caught by first_level_up_gather_s_worst (90 s, also applied to bots that gathered that long without levelling) and the 35 s median baseline. 2026-11-24 (ws/qa/per-skill-levelled): gathering is now timed per skill (gather_s_<skill>, level_gather_s_<skill>) because a bot's XP splits between felling and quarrying by the nodes it walks to. skill_unlevelled_gather_s_worst 60 s fails a bot that gathered 60 s in one skill and never levelled it (local run: every bot levelled felling after 23.6-37.8 s in it, so 60 s is ~1.6x the worst seen; the d9927b3 bots that missed had 43.8 s split over two skills and pass). skill_level_gather_s_median baseline 37 s (local 37.65) with 8 s slack, so it fails above 45 s; re-take from CI after three main runs. bots_levelled_min stays 6: the per-skill gate checks the curve, this one keeps 'most fresh players level in three minutes'. 2026-11-26 (remove the leveling system, owner direction): the level-up limits and baselines (first_level_up_gather_s, skill_level_gather_s, bots_levelled_min, skill_unlevelled_gather_s_worst) are gone with the levels. The other numbers are unchanged; s2c_xp and the level-up line arrived in the same tick as the haul they followed, so no feedback the metrics count was lost.
